Your role will focus on manual testing of TV applications, identifying and reporting defects, and verifying that users have a reliable and consistent viewing experience across supported platforms. You will collaborate with developers, solution architects, business analysts and other QA colleagues, while gradually developing your skills in test automation. What we will expect from you: Execute functional, regression and exploratory tests across TV, mobile and web applications. Test key features such as login, live TV, channel switching, the electronic programme guide (EPG), catch-up TV, video on demand, search and parental controls. Verify video and audio playback, playback controls and application behaviour under different network conditions. Check application compatibility across supported devices, operating systems, screen sizes and application versions. Test navigation and usability using remote controls, touchscreens and web browsers. Create and maintain test cases based on requirements and acceptance criteria. Document defects clearly, including steps to reproduce, device details, application versions and relevant screenshots, videos or logs. Track reported defects, verify fixes and communicate testing progress and results. Prepare and maintain test data and support the readiness of test devices and application configurations. Participate in project test phases and release validation. Use tools such as Jira, Confluence and TestRail. Analytical thinking and problem-solving skills. Good communication skills and a collaborative approach. The ability to organize tasks and work methodically. Good written and spoken English.
